About us

Built on one promise: do it properly, or don't do it at all

Pakistan Termite Control began in 2008 with a single technician, a single van and a frustration with how pest control was being done — quoted blind, sprayed carelessly, forgotten the moment the invoice was paid. We built the company we wished existed.

Our story

From one van to the twin cities' trusted name

What started as a small termite treatment operation in Rawalpindi — founded and still led by our CEO, Muhammad Riaz — grew the only way a service business honestly can: one satisfied client recommending us to the next. Fifteen-plus years later, our teams protect family homes, restaurant kitchens, school buildings, warehouses and government facilities across Islamabad, Rawalpindi and — for larger projects — all of Pakistan.

Along the way we widened our expertise beyond pests to the building itself, adding waterproofing, heat proofing and water tank cleaning — because the same property deserves the same standard of care, whatever is attacking it.

What hasn't changed is how we work: inspect first, quote in writing, treat properly, guarantee it, and answer the phone when you call afterwards.

Our mission

To protect every client's home, health and investment with safe, effective and honestly-priced treatments — delivered by professionals who treat your property like their own and stand behind their work in writing.

Our vision

To set the standard for pest control and building protection in Pakistan — proving that a local company can deliver international-grade service, safety and accountability on every job, from a single bedroom to an entire industrial estate.

What we stand for

How to Get Rid of Bed Bugs Permanently (and Why Sprays Keep Failing)

Bed bugs survive DIY sprays because the eggs and deep harbourages are never touched. Here's the protocol that actually ends an infestation — and how to avoid bringing them home again.

Know your enemy

Bed bugs are flat enough to hide inside a screw head. They live in mattress seams, bed frame joints, skirting gaps, electrical sockets and behind picture frames — emerging at night, feeding for a few minutes, and disappearing again. A female lays hundreds of eggs cemented into cracks, and those eggs are resistant to most consumer sprays. This is why the infestation always seems to 'come back': it never actually left.

Why DIY treatment fails

  • Consumer aerosols kill only the bugs they directly hit — a small fraction of the population
  • Eggs hatch 6–10 days later, restarting the cycle after you think you've won
  • Repellent sprays scatter bugs into neighbouring rooms, spreading the problem
  • Throwing away the mattress rarely helps — the frame, skirting and walls remain infested

The protocol that works

Professional eradication combines three elements. First, high-temperature dry steam — lethal to every life stage including eggs — applied slowly along seams, tufts, joints and skirting. Second, a targeted residual insecticide in cracks and frames that intercepts any survivor. Third, and most important, a follow-up visit 10–14 days later, timed to the hatching cycle, to eliminate nymphs before they mature and breed. Skip the follow-up and you've only paused the infestation.

Keeping them out for good

  • Inspect hotel beds — check mattress corners and the headboard before unpacking
  • Keep luggage on stands, never on the bed or floor
  • Wash and hot-dry all clothing immediately after travel
  • Inspect second-hand furniture carefully before it enters your home

Caught early, a bed bug problem is a two-visit fix. Left for months, it spreads through the house room by room. If you're waking up with bite lines or spotting rust-coloured marks on sheets, book an inspection now — it's the cheapest the problem will ever be.

Monsoon Pest Season in Pakistan: A Room-by-Room Prevention Checklist

Humidity wakes up every pest in the house. Here's the checklist we give our own clients before the rains arrive — kitchen, bathrooms, roof and garden.

Why pests explode during monsoon

Rain drives insects and rodents indoors, humidity accelerates breeding, and standing water turns every neglected corner into a mosquito nursery. In Islamabad and Rawalpindi, the weeks from late June through September account for a majority of the pest complaints we receive all year. The good news: most of it is preventable with an hour of preparation and, where needed, one pre-season treatment.

Kitchen

  • Seal gaps around sink pipes and under-counter voids — the number one cockroach highway
  • Store flour, rice and lentils in sealed containers; stored-product beetles thrive in humid months
  • Fix dripping taps; cockroaches can survive weeks without food but only days without water

Bathrooms & drains

  • Pour boiling water or a cup of vinegar down floor drains weekly
  • Use drain covers at night — the classic entry point for cockroaches
  • Repair seepage promptly; damp walls attract termites and silverfish

Roof & exterior

  • Clear roof drains and gutters before the first heavy rain
  • Empty anything holding standing water — pots, tyres, coolers, AC trays — every 3–4 days to break the dengue mosquito cycle
  • Trim vegetation touching exterior walls; branches are bridges for ants and rodents

When to call a professional

If you saw cockroaches, termites or rodents last season, treat before the monsoon rather than during it — pre-season residual treatment is dramatically more effective because it intercepts pests as they move in, instead of chasing an established population. A single pre-monsoon visit typically keeps a home protected through the entire season.

Is Roof Heat Proofing Worth It in Pakistan? Real Numbers, Honest Answers

Top-floor rooms hitting 38°C, AC bills climbing every summer. Here's how reflective roof coatings actually work, what temperature drop to expect, and when they're not the right fix.

The physics in one paragraph

A bare grey concrete roof absorbs most of the solar radiation that hits it, climbing past 65–70°C on a June afternoon in the twin cities. That heat soaks into the slab all day and radiates down into your rooms all evening — which is why top floors stay hot long after sunset. A high-albedo reflective coating reflects the majority of that radiation away before it enters the slab, so there is simply less heat to fight.

What temperature drop is realistic?

On top-floor rooms we typically measure indoor reductions of 4–8°C after coating, depending on roof condition, ceiling type and ventilation. The more noticeable effect for most families is the evening: rooms that used to stay hot until midnight cool down soon after sunset, and ACs reach set temperature faster and cycle off sooner.

The electricity math

Air conditioning dominates summer electricity bills in Pakistani homes. When roof heat gain drops, AC run-time drops with it. Most clients report their top-floor AC running noticeably fewer hours, and typical payback on the coating is one to two summers — after which the savings are simply yours. The coating also shields the roof surface from thermal cracking and adds water resistance.

When heat proofing is NOT the right answer

Honesty matters here: if your roof has active leakage, coat it for heat alone and you'll trap problems underneath. Fix waterproofing first — or use a combined waterproofing-plus-reflective system. Similarly, if the main heat source is large west-facing glass, the roof coating helps but window treatment matters too. A proper site assessment tells you where your heat is actually coming from before you spend.

Timing your application

Spring is ideal — the coating is in place before peak heat, and dry weather gives perfect curing conditions. Application on a typical house takes one to two days with no structural work, no debris and no need to vacate.

Termite Control 2026-07-107 min read

Termite (Deemak) Treatment in Islamabad & Rawalpindi: The Complete 2026 Guide

How to recognise deemak early, what pre- and post-construction treatment actually involves, what it costs, and how to choose a company that won't disappear after the invoice.

Why the twin cities are a termite hotspot

The soil profile and moisture conditions across Islamabad and Rawalpindi make the region ideal for subterranean termites. They move through soil, enter buildings through foundations and expansion joints, and feed on anything containing cellulose — door frames, wardrobes, skirting, parquet, paper archives and roof timbers. Because they eat wood from the inside out, most families discover the problem only when a door frame crumbles or mud tubes appear on a wall.

The early warning signs most people miss

  • Pencil-thick mud tubes running along walls, plinths or pipes
  • Wood that sounds hollow when tapped, or paint that bubbles and flakes
  • Doors and windows that suddenly stick as frames warp
  • Discarded insect wings on window sills, especially after rain
  • Fine powder (frass) beneath wooden furniture

Any one of these signs justifies an immediate professional inspection. Termite damage compounds quietly — a colony can consume significant structural wood in a single season, and repairs almost always cost more than treatment.

Pre-construction vs post-construction treatment

If you are building, pre-construction anti-termite treatment is the single best value in pest control: the soil beneath and around the foundation is treated before the slab is poured, creating a barrier that blocks termites for years. For existing buildings, post-construction treatment uses the drilling-and-injection method — small holes are drilled along the wall-floor junction at regular intervals, termiticide is injected to form a continuous underground barrier, and the holes are sealed and finished.

What a professional job looks like

A credible company inspects before quoting, names the chemicals it uses, states the dilution and coverage in writing, and issues a written multi-year warranty. Be cautious of anyone who quotes on the phone without an inspection, or offers a price that seems too good — under-dosed treatment fails within months, and you pay twice.

What does termite treatment cost?

Cost depends on covered area, construction type and infestation severity, which is why serious companies inspect first. At Pakistan Termite Control the inspection and quotation are free, the written price is final, and every treatment carries a written warranty with free re-treatment if termites return during the covered period.

Termite Control

How do I know if I have termites?

Common signs include mud tubes on walls, hollow-sounding wood, sagging door frames, discarded wings near windows and fine powder below wooden furniture. If you notice any of these, book an inspection immediately — early treatment costs far less than repairs.

Learn more about Termite Control

What is the difference between pre- and post-construction treatment?

Pre-construction treatment is applied to the soil and foundation during building, creating a barrier before termites ever reach the structure. Post-construction treatment protects existing buildings using drilling and injection along walls and floors.

How long does termite treatment last?

A professionally applied soil barrier typically protects a property for 5 to 10 years depending on soil conditions and construction type. Your written warranty specifies the exact coverage for your property.

Cockroach Control

Why do cockroaches keep coming back after spraying?

Household sprays kill only the cockroaches they touch and often scatter the rest deeper into hiding. Professional gel baiting eliminates the nest itself, which is why results last.

Learn more about Cockroach Control

Is gel treatment safe in kitchens?

Yes. Gel is applied in tiny hidden dots inside hinges, voids and corners — away from food and surfaces. It is the standard method used in restaurants and hospitals worldwide.

Learn more about Cockroach Control

How soon will I see results?

Activity typically drops sharply within 3–7 days, with full control in about two weeks after the follow-up visit.

Learn more about Cockroach Control

Bed Bug Treatment

Do I need to throw away my mattress?

Almost never. Professional steam and residual treatment can rescue mattresses and furniture in the vast majority of cases, saving you significant replacement costs.

Learn more about Bed Bug Treatment

How did I get bed bugs?

Bed bugs travel in luggage, second-hand furniture and clothing. Hotels, hostels, public transport and guest visits are the most common sources — an infestation is not a hygiene failure.

Learn more about Bed Bug Treatment

How should I prepare for treatment?

Wash bedding at 60°C, declutter around beds and keep the room accessible. We send a simple preparation checklist when you book.

Learn more about Bed Bug Treatment

Mosquito Control

When is the best time for mosquito treatment?

Just before and during the monsoon (June to October) is critical, as this is peak breeding and dengue season. Fogging is most effective at dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are active.

Learn more about Mosquito Control

Is fogging safe for my garden and pets?

Yes, when professionally applied. We advise keeping pets indoors during application and for a short period afterwards; plants are unaffected by correctly dosed treatments.

Learn more about Mosquito Control

Can you treat an entire housing society?

Absolutely. We run scheduled community-wide programmes covering streets, parks, drains and green belts — the most effective way to suppress mosquito populations at scale.

Learn more about Mosquito Control

Rodent Control

Are bait stations safe with children and pets at home?

Yes. We use locked, tamper-resistant stations that only rodents can enter, placed out of reach along walls and voids.

Learn more about Rodent Control

How long does it take to get rid of rats?

Most domestic infestations are brought under control within 2–3 weeks across two to three visits, depending on population size and site conditions.

Learn more about Rodent Control

Why do rats keep coming back?

Because entry points remain open. Our proofing service seals gaps, drains and duct penetrations — without it, new rodents simply move into the vacant territory.

Learn more about Rodent Control

Lizard Control

Are house lizards dangerous?

Common house geckos are not venomous, but their droppings can contaminate food and kitchen surfaces, and most families simply don't want them indoors. Our treatment keeps them out safely.

Learn more about Lizard Control

Why do lizards keep appearing near my lights?

Lights attract flying insects, which are the lizards' food. Reducing insects around lights and windows is the single most effective way to make lizards leave.

Learn more about Lizard Control

Fumigation Services

How long must premises stay vacant during fumigation?

Depending on the fumigant and infestation, exposure plus ventilation typically takes 24–72 hours. We confirm the exact timeline in your treatment plan.

Learn more about Fumigation Services

Do you issue fumigation certificates for exports?

Yes. We provide consignment and container fumigation with certificates accepted for export documentation.

Learn more about Fumigation Services

Is fumigation the same as fogging?

No. Fogging disperses insecticide droplets for flying insects and surfaces; fumigation fills a sealed space with penetrating gas that eliminates pests inside goods, cracks and structures. We'll recommend the right method for your situation.

Learn more about Fumigation Services

Waterproofing

Why does my roof leak again every monsoon despite repairs?

Cement patching cracks with thermal movement. Elastomeric membrane systems stay flexible through summer heat and winter cold, which is why they last where patching fails.

Learn more about Waterproofing

Can bathrooms be waterproofed without breaking all the tiles?

In many cases yes — penetrating chemical treatments and targeted grouting can stop seepage without full demolition. We confirm the right approach after inspection.

Learn more about Waterproofing

How long does roof waterproofing last?

A properly applied membrane system typically lasts 7–10 years or more. Your warranty specifies the coverage for the system installed.

Learn more about Waterproofing

Heat Proofing

How much cooler will my rooms actually get?

Top-floor rooms typically drop 4–8°C depending on roof condition, insulation and ventilation. The reduction in AC running time is usually noticeable within the first week.

Learn more about Heat Proofing

Does heat proofing also stop leakage?

Quality heat-proof coatings add meaningful water resistance, but if you have active leakage we recommend a combined waterproofing plus heat-proofing system for a permanent fix.

Learn more about Heat Proofing

When is the best time to apply heat proofing?

Spring — before peak summer — is ideal, but application is possible in any dry weather window year-round.

Learn more about Heat Proofing

Water Tank Cleaning

How often should a water tank be cleaned?

Every six months is the recommended standard for household tanks in Pakistan; annually is the absolute minimum. Tanks supplying drinking water should never go beyond a year.

Learn more about Water Tank Cleaning

How long does tank cleaning take?

A typical household tank takes 2–3 hours including disinfection and refill. Larger underground tanks may take half a day.

Learn more about Water Tank Cleaning

Will there be any chemical taste afterwards?

No. We use food-safe disinfectants and rinse thoroughly until the water is completely clear and neutral.

Learn more about Water Tank Cleaning

Call or WhatsApp — a specialist (not a call script) will give you a straight answer.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-07-29

Who we are

Pakistan Termite Control ("we", "us") operates https://pakpestcontrol.com and provides pest control and building protection services across Pakistan. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.

Information we collect

When you contact us via phone, WhatsApp, email or our website forms, we collect the details you provide: your name, phone number, address or area, and a description of the service you need. Our website forms send this information directly to our WhatsApp business line; we do not store form submissions on this website's servers.

How we use your information

We use your details solely to respond to your enquiry, schedule inspections and services, issue quotes and warranty documents, and follow up on completed work. We may occasionally inform past clients about seasonal treatments relevant to their previous service.

What we never do

We never sell, rent or trade your personal information. We never share your details with third parties except where required to deliver your service (for example, dispatching a technician) or where required by law.

Cookies and analytics

This website uses no tracking cookies by default. If analytics are added in future, they will be privacy-respecting and this policy will be updated accordingly. Embedded maps and videos (Google Maps, YouTube) may set their own cookies when you interact with them, governed by their respective privacy policies.

Data retention

Service records and warranty documents are retained for the duration of your warranty period plus reasonable business record-keeping. You may request deletion of your contact details at any time.

Your rights

You may request a copy of the information we hold about you, ask for corrections, or request deletion by contacting us at bkclass11@gmail.com or 0300 8365575.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be published on this page.

Bed Bug Treatment · Islamabad & Rawalpindi

Take your bedroom back. Sleep without being bitten.

Heat, steam and residual treatment that reaches every seam, crack and hiding place — so you sleep in peace again.

Book Free Inspection WhatsApp Us

The problem & our approach

Why professional bed bug treatment matters

Bed bugs are among the hardest pests to eliminate — they hide in mattress seams, bed frames, skirting, sockets and even picture frames, and they survive months without feeding. DIY sprays almost always fail because they miss the eggs and the deep harbourages.

Our protocol combines high-temperature steam (lethal to bugs and eggs on contact), targeted residual treatment of cracks and frames, and a mandatory follow-up visit timed to the hatching cycle. It's thorough, discreet and proven in homes, hostels and hotels across the twin cities.

What you get with us

  • Kills bugs and eggsSteam destroys all life stages on contact; residual treatment catches anything that emerges later.
  • Whole-room protocolWe treat beds, frames, furniture joints, skirting, sockets and luggage zones — not just the mattress.
  • Discreet serviceUnmarked service available for hotels, hostels and guest houses that need the problem solved quietly.
  • Follow-up guaranteedA second visit is built into every job to break the egg-hatch cycle completely.

Our process

How the treatment works

Room-by-room inspection

We confirm the infestation, trace its spread and identify every harbourage.

Steam treatment

Professional dry-steam at over 120°C is applied to seams, tufts, frames and joints.

Residual application

Cracks, frames and skirting receive a targeted residual insecticide to intercept stragglers.

Scheduled follow-up

We return within 10–14 days to eliminate any newly hatched nymphs and confirm eradication.

Why choose us

The team behind the warranty

Fifteen-plus years, twelve thousand properties, one standard: do it properly or don't do it at all.

  • Inspection before quotationWe never price a job blind — you get a fixed written quote after a real survey.
  • Licensed, uniformed techniciansTrained applicators who explain what they're doing and why.
  • Warranty in writingEvery treatment is backed by a written service warranty and free re-treatment if pests return within the covered period.
  • Respect for your propertyClean work, sealed drill points, tidy exits — every single visit.

Good to know

Bed Bug Treatment — your questions answered

Do I need to throw away my mattress?

Almost never. Professional steam and residual treatment can rescue mattresses and furniture in the vast majority of cases, saving you significant replacement costs.

How did I get bed bugs?

Bed bugs travel in luggage, second-hand furniture and clothing. Hotels, hostels, public transport and guest visits are the most common sources — an infestation is not a hygiene failure.

How should I prepare for treatment?

Wash bedding at 60°C, declutter around beds and keep the room accessible. We send a simple preparation checklist when you book.

Cockroach Control · Islamabad & Rawalpindi

Kill the colony, not just the cockroach you can see.

Advanced gel-bait treatment that wipes out the entire colony — kitchens stay usable, no smell, no mess.

The problem & our approach

Why professional cockroach control matters

For every cockroach you see at night, dozens more are hiding inside cabinet hinges, motor compartments and wall voids. Sprays alone scatter them deeper. Our approach uses professional gel baits with a cascade effect: foraging cockroaches carry the bait back to the harbourage, poisoning the nest — including the egg-laying females you never see.

The treatment is odourless, requires no emptying of kitchens, and is safe around food-preparation areas when applied by our trained technicians. Most clients see a dramatic drop within days and complete control within two weeks.

What you get with us

  • Colony-level eliminationGel bait spreads through the population via contact and cannibalism, destroying the nest — not just the foragers.
  • No smell, no evacuationKitchens and restaurants keep operating. No fumes, no residue on worktops, no downtime.
  • Restaurant & food-business readyHACCP-conscious application with service documentation for food authority inspections.
  • Follow-up includedA scheduled follow-up visit ensures newly hatched nymphs are eliminated before they breed.

Our process

How the treatment works

Inspection & mapping

We locate harbourages — hinges, voids, appliances, drains — and gauge the infestation level.

Precision gel baiting

Micro-dots of professional gel are placed exactly where cockroaches travel and feed.

Crack & crevice treatment

Residual treatment of voids and entry routes intercepts cockroaches moving between units.

Follow-up visit

We re-inspect, refresh bait points and confirm the population has collapsed.

Good to know

Cockroach Control — your questions answered

Why do cockroaches keep coming back after spraying?

Household sprays kill only the cockroaches they touch and often scatter the rest deeper into hiding. Professional gel baiting eliminates the nest itself, which is why results last.

Is gel treatment safe in kitchens?

Yes. Gel is applied in tiny hidden dots inside hinges, voids and corners — away from food and surfaces. It is the standard method used in restaurants and hospitals worldwide.

How soon will I see results?

Activity typically drops sharply within 3–7 days, with full control in about two weeks after the follow-up visit.

The problem & our approach

Why professional fumigation services matters

Some infestations can't be solved with sprays and baits alone. Stored-product pests in warehouses, deep infestations in godowns, and pre-shipment requirements for export consignments call for professional fumigation — a controlled, whole-space treatment that reaches every void, pallet and crevice.

We provide certified fumigation for residential, commercial and industrial premises, as well as container and consignment fumigation with proper documentation. Every job follows strict exposure, ventilation and safety protocols managed by trained supervisors.

What you get with us

  • Whole-space penetrationFumigants reach voids, stacked goods and hidden harbourages that surface treatments can never touch.
  • Certified & documentedFumigation certificates provided for export consignments, audits and regulatory requirements.
  • Warehouse & godown specialistsProtection for grain, textiles, paper and packaged goods from beetles, weevils and moths.
  • Strict safety protocolsSealing, warning signage, exposure control and ventilation clearance handled end-to-end by trained supervisors.

Assessment & planning

We evaluate the commodity or premises, target pest and required exposure standard.

Sealing & preparation

The space is sealed, occupants and goods prepared, and safety signage posted.

Controlled fumigation

Fumigant is released and monitored for the required exposure period.

Ventilation & certification

Fifteen-plus years, twelve thousand properties, one standard: do it properly or don't do it at all.

Good to know

Fumigation Services — your questions answered

How long must premises stay vacant during fumigation?

Depending on the fumigant and infestation, exposure plus ventilation typically takes 24–72 hours. We confirm the exact timeline in your treatment plan.

Do you issue fumigation certificates for exports?

Yes. We provide consignment and container fumigation with certificates accepted for export documentation.

Is fumigation the same as fogging?

No. Fogging disperses insecticide droplets for flying insects and surfaces; fumigation fills a sealed space with penetrating gas that eliminates pests inside goods, cracks and structures. We'll recommend the right method for your situation.

Heat Proofing · Islamabad & Rawalpindi

Cooler rooms in summer. Lower electricity bills. One coating.

Reflective roof coatings that cut indoor temperatures by up to 6–8°C and slash summer cooling bills.

Book Free Inspection WhatsApp Us

The problem & our approach

Why professional heat proofing matters

In peak summer, an untreated concrete roof in Rawalpindi or Islamabad can reach over 70°C — and radiates that heat into your rooms all evening, forcing ACs to run harder and longer. Heat-reflective roof coatings tackle the problem at the source by bouncing solar radiation away before it ever enters the slab.

We apply high-albedo reflective coatings that measurably drop indoor temperatures — typically 4 to 8°C on top-floor rooms — reduce AC load and electricity bills, and simultaneously add a water-resistant protective layer to your roof. It's one of the highest-return improvements you can make to a home in Pakistan's climate.

What you get with us

  • Up to 6–8°C cooler roomsHigh-reflectance coatings reject solar heat before it soaks into the roof slab.
  • Lower electricity billsReduced AC load means real savings every summer month — the coating pays for itself.
  • Dual protectionQuality heat-proof coatings also resist water penetration, extending your roof's life.
  • Fast, non-disruptive applicationMost homes are completed within 1–2 days with no structural work.

Roof assessment

We check the surface condition, existing cracks and drainage before recommending a system.

Cleaning & repair

The roof is cleaned and cracks are filled so the coating bonds properly.

Multi-coat application

Reflective coating is applied in multiple layers at the specified coverage rate.

Final inspection

Coverage and finish are verified, with care guidance so the coating performs for years.

The problem & our approach

Why professional lizard control matters

Lizards enter homes for one reason: food. Where there are insects around lights, windows and kitchens, lizards follow. That's why repellent sprays alone give only temporary relief — the lizards return as soon as the food supply does.

Our approach fixes the cause. We reduce the insect population that attracts lizards, apply safe repellent treatments at entry points and resting spots, and advise on lighting and sealing changes that make your home permanently less inviting to them.

What you get with us

  • Cause-based controlBy cutting off the insect food supply, we remove the reason lizards enter in the first place.
  • Humane & family-safeDeterrent-first methods, safe for homes with children, elderly family members and pets.
  • Entry-point treatmentWindows, vents, AC ducts and gaps behind frames are treated and sealing advice provided.
  • Lasting resultsCombined insect control plus deterrence keeps walls and ceilings clear far longer than sprays alone.

Our process

How the treatment works

Inspection

We identify entry points, resting spots behind frames and appliances, and the insect sources attracting them.

Insect-source treatment

A targeted general insect treatment removes the food supply around lights, windows and kitchens.

Repellent application

Safe repellent formulations are applied along entry routes, ceilings corners and resting zones.

Prevention advice

Simple lighting, screening and sealing changes that keep lizards from returning.

Good to know

Lizard Control — your questions answered

Are house lizards dangerous?

Common house geckos are not venomous, but their droppings can contaminate food and kitchen surfaces, and most families simply don't want them indoors. Our treatment keeps them out safely.

Why do lizards keep appearing near my lights?

Lights attract flying insects, which are the lizards' food. Reducing insects around lights and windows is the single most effective way to make lizards leave.

The problem & our approach

Why professional mosquito control matters

In the twin cities, mosquitoes are more than a nuisance — dengue season makes them a genuine health risk for your family. Effective control means attacking mosquitoes at every life stage: killing adults where they rest, and eliminating the standing-water breeding sites that produce thousands more each week.

We run thermal fogging and residual spraying for gardens, lawns and compounds, combined with larviciding of drains, tanks and water collection points. For housing societies and institutions, we operate scheduled seasonal programmes that keep entire communities protected through peak season.

What you get with us

  • Dengue-focused protocolsTreatment plans built around Aedes mosquito behaviour — the species behind dengue in Pakistan.
  • Adults and larvae targetedFogging knocks down adult mosquitoes while larvicides stop the next generation in drains and standing water.
  • Society-wide programmesScheduled seasonal contracts for housing societies, schools, mosques and commercial compounds.
  • Garden-safe applicationProducts and timings chosen to protect plants, birds and beneficial insects as far as possible.

Site survey

We map resting sites, vegetation and every standing-water breeding point on the property.

Source reduction & larviciding

Breeding sites are treated or eliminated so the population stops regenerating.

Fogging & residual spray

Thermal fogging and barrier sprays knock down adult mosquitoes in gardens, shaded walls and outdoor areas.

Seasonal schedule

Repeat treatments are timed to the monsoon and dengue season for continuous protection.

Good to know

Mosquito Control — your questions answered

When is the best time for mosquito treatment?

Just before and during the monsoon (June to October) is critical, as this is peak breeding and dengue season. Fogging is most effective at dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are active.

Is fogging safe for my garden and pets?

Yes, when professionally applied. We advise keeping pets indoors during application and for a short period afterwards; plants are unaffected by correctly dosed treatments.

Can you treat an entire housing society?

Absolutely. We run scheduled community-wide programmes covering streets, parks, drains and green belts — the most effective way to suppress mosquito populations at scale.

The problem & our approach

Why professional rodent control matters

A single pair of rats can produce hundreds of descendants in a year. Beyond contaminating food and spreading disease, rodents gnaw electrical wiring — one of the leading hidden causes of short circuits and fires in homes and warehouses.

Our rodent programme pairs professional-grade baiting and trapping with the step most companies skip: proofing. We physically seal the gaps, pipes ducts and door thresholds rodents use to enter, so the ones we remove aren't simply replaced by newcomers.

What you get with us

  • Removal plus preventionWe eliminate the current population and close the entry routes — the only way to get lasting results.
  • Tamper-resistant bait stationsLocked, anchored stations keep bait away from children, pets and non-target animals.
  • Warehouse & food-business expertiseDocumented rodent management for stores, restaurants and industrial units, audit-ready.
  • Hygiene guidancePractical advice on storage and waste handling that removes the attractants.

Survey & mapping

Droppings, gnaw marks, burrows and grease trails tell us the species, population and runways.

Baiting & trapping

Proofing & exclusion

Entry gaps, pipe penetrations and thresholds are sealed with rodent-proof materials.

Monitoring visits

Rodent Control — your questions answered

Are bait stations safe with children and pets at home?

Yes. We use locked, tamper-resistant stations that only rodents can enter, placed out of reach along walls and voids.

How long does it take to get rid of rats?

Most domestic infestations are brought under control within 2–3 weeks across two to three visits, depending on population size and site conditions.

Why do rats keep coming back?

Because entry points remain open. Our proofing service seals gaps, drains and duct penetrations — without it, new rodents simply move into the vacant territory.

Termite Control · Islamabad & Rawalpindi

Termites destroy silently. We stop them permanently.

The problem & our approach

Why professional termite control matters

Termites — known locally as deemak — cause more structural damage in Pakistan than fire and storms combined. They work out of sight inside walls, door frames, wardrobes and foundations, and by the time you spot the first mud tube, colonies numbering in the hundreds of thousands are usually already established.

Our termite programme goes beyond surface sprays. We trace the colony to its entry points, treat the soil and structure with government-approved termiticides, and build a chemical barrier that keeps termites out for years — not weeks. Every treatment is documented and covered by a written warranty.

What you get with us

  • Root-cause eliminationWe treat the soil, foundations and entry routes — not just the visible damage — so the colony itself is destroyed.
  • Pre & post-construction optionsFoundation treatment for new builds, and drilling-and-injection barriers for existing homes and offices.
  • Written multi-year warrantyYour treatment is documented and guaranteed. If termites return within the warranty period, we re-treat free of charge.
  • Safe for families & petsOdourless, government-approved termiticides applied by licensed technicians with full safety protocols.

Our process

How the treatment works

Detailed inspection

We examine foundations, woodwork, skirting, wardrobes and moisture-prone zones to map colony activity and entry points.

Customised treatment plan

You receive a clear written scope — method, chemicals, timeline and cost — before any work begins.

Barrier treatment

We drill discreet holes along walls at regular intervals and inject termiticide to form a continuous soil barrier, then seal and clean every point.

Warranty & follow-up

We schedule follow-up visits, monitor treated zones and remain on call for the full warranty period.

Why choose us

The team behind the warranty

Fifteen-plus years, twelve thousand properties, one standard: do it properly or don't do it at all.

  • Inspection before quotationWe never price a job blind — you get a fixed written quote after a real survey.
  • Licensed, uniformed techniciansTrained applicators who explain what they're doing and why.

  • Respect for your propertyClean work, sealed drill points, tidy exits — every single visit.

Good to know

Termite Control — your questions answered

How do I know if I have termites?

Common signs include mud tubes on walls, hollow-sounding wood, sagging door frames, discarded wings near windows and fine powder below wooden furniture. If you notice any of these, book an inspection immediately — early treatment costs far less than repairs.

What is the difference between pre- and post-construction treatment?

Pre-construction treatment is applied to the soil and foundation during building, creating a barrier before termites ever reach the structure. Post-construction treatment protects existing buildings using drilling and injection along walls and floors.

How long does termite treatment last?

A professionally applied soil barrier typically protects a property for 5 to 10 years depending on soil conditions and construction type. Your written warranty specifies the exact coverage for your property.

Is the treatment safe for children and pets?

Yes. We use odourless, government-approved formulations and follow strict application protocols. We will advise you on any short re-entry intervals for treated rooms.

The problem & our approach

Why professional water tank cleaning matters

Sludge, algae, rust and bacterial biofilm build up silently at the bottom of every water tank. That layer contaminates the water your family drinks, bathes in and cooks with — and it's a standing invitation for waterborne illness, especially for children and the elderly.

Our teams empty, scrub, pressure-wash and disinfect overhead and underground tanks of every size using safe, approved disinfectants — then rinse until the water runs clear. We recommend cleaning every six months; most families are shocked by what comes out the first time.

What you get with us

  • Safer water for your familyRemoval of sludge, algae and biofilm measurably improves water hygiene at every tap.
  • Overhead & underground tanksConcrete, plastic and fibreglass tanks of all sizes — residential and commercial.
  • Safe disinfectionFood-safe, approved disinfectants with a thorough final rinse — no chemical aftertaste.
  • Complete serviceSludge removal and disposal, valve and float check, and photos of before/after condition.

Our process

How the treatment works

Draining & sludge removal

The tank is emptied and all settled sludge and debris removed.

Scrubbing & pressure wash

Walls, floor and corners are scrubbed and high-pressure washed.

Disinfection

Approved disinfectant treatment eliminates bacteria and biofilm, followed by full rinsing.

Refill & report

The tank is refilled, fittings checked, and before/after photos shared with you.

Good to know

Water Tank Cleaning — your questions answered

How often should a water tank be cleaned?

Every six months is the recommended standard for household tanks in Pakistan; annually is the absolute minimum. Tanks supplying drinking water should never go beyond a year.

How long does tank cleaning take?

A typical household tank takes 2–3 hours including disinfection and refill. Larger underground tanks may take half a day.

Will there be any chemical taste afterwards?

No. We use food-safe disinfectants and rinse thoroughly until the water is completely clear and neutral.

Waterproofing · Islamabad & Rawalpindi

Stop leakage and seepage before it eats your building.

Book Free Inspection WhatsApp Us

The problem & our approach

Why professional waterproofing matters

Water is as destructive as termites — it just works slower. Roof leakage, bathroom seepage and damp walls ruin paint and plaster, corrode steel reinforcement, trigger mould, and create exactly the moist conditions termites love. Patching with cement rarely lasts a single monsoon.

We apply proven waterproofing systems — elastomeric membranes, chemical coatings and crack injection — matched to each surface: flat roofs, bathrooms, basements, water tanks and exterior walls. Surfaces are properly prepared, primed and coated so the fix holds for years, and the work is covered by a written warranty.

What you get with us

  • Right system for each surfaceMembrane, bitumen, acrylic and PU systems — selected for the surface and exposure, not one product for everything.
  • Monsoon-proven durabilityProper surface preparation and multi-coat application built to survive Rawalpindi–Islamabad's heavy rains.
  • Protects structure & healthStops rebar corrosion, plaster damage and the damp that breeds mould and attracts termites.
  • Written warrantyWaterproofing work is documented and guaranteed in writing.

Our process

How the treatment works

Leak diagnosis

We trace the actual water path — often far from the visible damp patch — before recommending anything.

Surface preparation

Cracks are opened and filled, surfaces cleaned, slopes corrected and primed for adhesion.

System application

Membrane or coating layers are applied at specified thickness with reinforcement at joints and drains.

Flood test & handover

Roofs and tanks are water-tested before handover, and your warranty documentation is issued.

The team behind the warranty

Good to know

Waterproofing — your questions answered

Why does my roof leak again every monsoon despite repairs?

Cement patching cracks with thermal movement. Elastomeric membrane systems stay flexible through summer heat and winter cold, which is why they last where patching fails.

Can bathrooms be waterproofed without breaking all the tiles?

In many cases yes — penetrating chemical treatments and targeted grouting can stop seepage without full demolition. We confirm the right approach after inspection.

How long does roof waterproofing last?

A properly applied membrane system typically lasts 7–10 years or more. Your warranty specifies the coverage for the system installed.
